Thank you for using tidyMacro! I built it for my own research, and it makes me genuinely happy every time I hear that it is useful to someone else. It is free and open source, and it will always stay that way.

*If tidyMacro saved you some time, or a few late nights, you might like to pass a little of that on by supporting a children's or education charity of your choice.*

***Just to be clear: I have no affiliation with the organisations below and receive nothing from any donation. They are only suggestions, and any cause close to your heart is just as welcome.***

## Some suggestions

A few organisations doing wonderful work for children and education:

- [UNICEF](https://www.unicef.org/take-action): works for children's health, protection and education in more than 190 countries and territories.
- [Save the Children](https://www.savethechildren.net/): supports children's health, education and protection, including in emergencies.
- [Room to Read](https://www.roomtoread.org/): focuses on childhood literacy and girls' education in low-income countries.
- [Malala Fund](https://malala.org/): works for girls' access to twelve years of free, safe, quality education.

## Donations reported by users

Research can do good in many ways, and this is one I find especially heartwarming: knowing that tidyMacro might, even in a small way, help children and their education is a big part of what keeps me going. The chart below keeps track of what users have kindly reported.

```{r}
#| include: false
# Anonymous Google Form (date + amount in EUR, e-mail collection off). Only the
# monthly-totals tab of the response sheet is published as CSV, never the raw
# responses. Expected columns: month (e.g. 2026-09 or 2026-09-01), total.
form_url <- "https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScIKjkOcvY9tW5vufe7dI0W3iR1tfb4FwE0wA0UfA33Gflnxg/viewform?usp=dialog"
csv_url  <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-1vRJ9SX1yilPbD0Sn3yjogpwx--gplKY9OzSmHv8Btpf9Sipc4odsBz2fM82-37OkRR1TmO2d1ce1UAz/pub?gid=1545958266&single=true&output=csv"

read_monthly <- function(url) {
    if (!nzchar(url)) return(NULL)
    tryCatch({
        d <- utils::read.csv(url, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
        names(d) <- tolower(trimws(names(d)))
        m <- substr(as.character(d$month), 1, 7)
        d <- data.frame(
            month = as.Date(paste0(m, "-01")),
            total = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(d$total))
        )
        d <- d[!is.na(d$month) & !is.na(d$total), ]
        if (nrow(d) == 0) NULL else d[order(d$month), ]
    }, error = function(e) NULL)
}

donations <- read_monthly(csv_url)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
if (nzchar(form_url)) {
    cat("If you donated because of tidyMacro, I would love to hear about it! You can [let me know anonymously](",
        form_url, "): the form asks only for the date and the amount, no name or e-mail.\n\n",
        sep = "")
}
if (is.null(donations)) {
    cat("*No donations have been reported yet; the monthly chart will appear here as soon as the first one comes in.*\n")
} else {
    cat("These figures are self-reported and cannot be verified, so the real total is probably higher. A heartfelt thank you to everyone who has given!\n")
}
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5
if (!is.null(donations)) {
    library(ggplot2)
    ggplot(donations, aes(x = month, y = total)) +
        geom_col(fill = tidyMacro::tidyMacro_colors[1], width = 25) +
        scale_x_date(date_labels = "%b %Y") +
        labs(x = NULL, y = "Reported donations (EUR)",
             caption = "Donations reported by users; not verified.") +
        tidyMacro::fThemeTidyMacro()
}
```
